events.verdict: Wells (MEM) initiates contact with Fox's (SAS) arm after his gather, and the contact affects his shot attempt.  The contact occurs prior to, and causes, any potential travel by Fox.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) and Barnes (SAS) briefly engage and disengage after the expiration of the pick.
Coward (MEM) runs into Edey (MEM) and he goes to the floor as a result of the contact from Edey and not as a result of any contact from Champagnie (SAS).
Kornet (SAS) deflects the ball away from Edey (MEM) as they pursue the rebound.
Barnes (SAS) establishes himself in Wells' (MEM) path prior to the contact.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) directly contests Fox's (SAS) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Fox's (SAS) hand after the release.
Fox (SAS) cleanly deflects the ball away from Coward (MEM).
After the ball becomes loose, Fox (SAS) clamps Coward's (MEM) arm and affects his ability to pursue the loose ball.
Williams Jr. (MEM) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Champagnie (SAS) initiates body to body contact with Spencer (MEM) that affects his SQBR at the start of his drive.
Barnes (SAS) establishes himself in Wells' (MEM) path prior to the contact.
Wells (MEM) initiates contact with Fox's (SAS) arm and the contact affects his ability to control the ball.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) gathers the ball on his left foot and takes one step before legally releasing his dribble.
Barnes (SAS) legally contests Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Johnson (SAS) initiates contact with Edey's (MEM) arm prior to making any contact with the ball.
Wells (MEM) commits a take foul on Fox (SAS).
Barnes (SAS) legally contests Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) jump shot attempt.
